Installation questions.

Where, what is included, support and training.

Where does i9TV install?

In Florida and in Brazil, i9TV installs, configures and trains. Elsewhere in Latin America it does the same under an installation, configuration and training contract. For anywhere else, ask: who installs, and the cost, is set per project with a specialist.

What does installation include?

The equipment mounted, cabled and powered in your room; the system configured (cameras, switcher, streaming, audio); and your team trained to run it. The scope is written into the quote for each project.

Is there a support plan after installation?

Yes, as an option. A support plan (SLA) is quoted with the project, sized to the system and how you use it.

Can you train our volunteers?

Training is part of the service: the people who will run the room on a normal week learn it on their own equipment.

Do you install LED walls too?

i9TV designs and installs LED walls together with sound and broadcast systems. LED walls are built to order and quoted with the factory; size yours in the LED wall configurator first.
